parsed.reason: Description A says the loop breaks after the final failed attempt and charge() returns None, causing an AttributeError downstream. Description B says the except clause retries all GatewayErrors, including permanent declines, wasting attempts and sleeps. Both point at the same retry block, but they identify different failures: one is a return-value/exit-path bug, the other is an over-broad retry-classification issue.
